stories.title: Execution of Christa Pike halted at the last minute by a Tennessee appeals court

en.title: Execution of Christa Pike halted at the last minute by a Tennessee appeals court
en.summary: A Tennessee appeals court stopped the execution of Christa Pike, who was 18 when she killed a fellow student in 1995. Her defense team has requested that her death sentence be commuted to life imprisonment.

stories.title: Guardiola expresa su apoyo al City: «Los amo a todos, pasaremos esto juntos»

en.title: Guardiola expresses his support for City: "I love them all, we will get through this together"
en.summary: Pep Guardiola, Manchester City's former manager, expressed support for the club after the Premier League found it guilty of breaching over one hundred financial regulations between 2009 and 2018. Guardiola, who won approximately twenty titles including the 2023 Champions League during his tenure, remains confident in the club's innocence.

stories.title: Spanish-Argentine expedition to verify whether a geoglyph located in the Andes via Google Earth is genuine

en.title: Spanish-Argentine expedition to verify whether a geoglyph located in the Andes via Google Earth is genuine
en.summary: Researchers from Spain and Argentina will investigate a geoglyph discovered in the Andes through Google Earth to determine whether it is an authentic sacred structure from the Inca period.

stories.title: Intento de atentado en un vuelo rumbo a Israel: un piloto trata de apuñalar al otro y estrellar el avión

en.title: Attempted attack on a flight headed to Israel: one pilot attempts to stab the other and crash the plane
en.summary: A pilot on a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv attempted to stab the other pilot and crash the aircraft. The flight landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, with Israeli officials describing the incident as a jihadist attack.

stories.title: Telefónica desmonta el consejo de Movistar Plus+ en vísperas del estreno de La Séptima

en.title: Telefónica dismantles Movistar Plus+ board ahead of La Séptima premiere
en.summary: Telefónica has decided to dismantle the board of directors of its audiovisual platform Movistar Plus+, which was previously chaired by Javier de Paz, a close associate of former president José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero.

stories.title: Gabriel Rufián: «El PSOE, cada vez que puede escoger entre un inquilino precario y un gran propietario, elige al segundo»

en.title: Gabriel Rufián: "The PSOE, whenever it can choose between a precarious tenant and a large landlord, chooses the latter"
en.summary: Spain's housing crisis has intensified following the eviction of an 87-year-old woman in Madrid, though she later reached an agreement to return home. The Government has approved two housing-related royal decrees addressing tenant protections.

stories.title: El Gobierno quiere obligar a los caseros a pagar 12 meses a los inquilinos si no prorrogan el alquiler

en.title: The Government wants to force landlords to pay 12 months to tenants if they do not renew the lease
en.summary: A housing decree promoted by Sumar proposes indefinite rental contracts with substantial compensation that landlords must pay if they terminate the agreement, automatically extending existing leases after their current terms expire.

stories.title: Israel investiga como ataque terrorista el incidente del vuelo de Flydubai: "Uno de los pilotos apuñaló al otro. Al parecer, intentó estrellar el avión con sus ocupantes"

en.title: Israel investigates Flydubai flight incident as terrorist attack: "One of the pilots stabbed the other. Apparently, he tried to crash the plane with its occupants"
en.summary: An incident aboard a Flydubai flight resulted in an emergency alert and diversion to Saudi Arabia instead of landing at Ben Gurión airport. Israel is investigating the incident as a potential terrorist attack involving two pilots.

stories.title: Sánchez ignora la "decepción" inicial de Junts con el decreto de Vivienda: "Soy razonablemente optimista"

en.title: Sánchez ignores initial "disappointment" from Junts over Housing decree: "I am reasonably optimistic"
en.summary: The Catalan party avoids revealing how it will vote on the government's housing decree while noting that two key issues regarding vulture funds and family protection are not addressed as they intended.

stories.title: Sánchez se muestra “razonablemente optimista” para convalidar los dos decretos ley de vivienda

en.title: Sánchez shows "reasonable optimism" for validating two housing decree-laws
en.summary: French President Macron expresses solidarity with Spain over the migration crisis in Ceuta, describing it as an attack, while lamenting that the PP blocked a friendship treaty in the Senate as a setback rather than a crisis.

stories.title: Sánchez, “razonablemente optimista” sobre la convalidación de los decretos de vivienda: “Me gusta ser traidor a los fondos buitre”

en.title: Sánchez "reasonably optimistic" about validation of housing decrees: "I like being a traitor to vulture funds"
en.summary: Left-wing allies are pressuring Podemos to allow housing measures approved by the Cabinet to advance as a starting point for further negotiations.

stories.title: Netanyahu apunta a que un piloto intentó estrellar el avión de FlyDubai tras apuñalar a su compañero

en.title: Netanyahu suggests a pilot attempted to crash FlyDubai aircraft after stabbing his colleague
en.summary: A second crew member stabbed the pilot and prevented a catastrophe aboard the flight, though the motives behind the incident remain unclear.

stories.title: El piloto de un vuelo con destino a Israel intentó estrellar el avión, según Netanyahu

en.title: Pilot of flight bound for Israel attempted to crash the plane, according to Netanyahu
en.summary: Israeli officials describe an incident involving a pilot on a flight to Israel as a planned attack comparable to September 11. Details of the incident were characterized as a deliberate attempt to crash the aircraft.

stories.title: El Ibex encadena su tercera sesión a la baja y salda septiembre con una caída del 2,7%

en.title: The Ibex falls for a third consecutive session and closes September with a 2.7% drop
en.summary: Spain's Ibex index declined for the third straight trading session and posted a 2.7% loss for September. Stabilization in oil and debt markets may support a rebound, as investors await key inflation data from the U.S. Federal Reserve.

stories.title: Gonzalo Bernardos: "El decreto de vivienda del Gobierno va a hundir la oferta de alquiler más de un 20%"

en.title: Gonzalo Bernardos: "The Government's housing decree will slash rental supply by over 20%"
en.summary: A real estate expert warns that government housing measures will cause many landlords to exit the rental market by selling properties, potentially raising prices and reducing access for renters. The decree is predicted to significantly reduce available rental housing.

stories.title: Alemania y el resto de 'frugales' piden rebajar "cientos de miles de millones" el presupuesto de la UE

en.title: Germany and other 'frugal' countries call for cutting "hundreds of billions" from EU budget
en.summary: Germany, the Netherlands, Austria, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark sent a joint letter requesting substantial cuts to the European Commission's proposed two trillion euro budget. These countries oppose the spending levels that were presented before summer 2024.

stories.title: Los inversores en centros de datos piden un marco regulatorio estable

en.title: Data center investors seek stable regulatory framework
en.summary: Data center investors have expressed concern about a newly announced royal decree affecting the sector and are calling for a stable and reasonable regulatory framework to continue attracting investment.
